title: ai-rulez change result
description: Output of `--format json` of add, remove, edit, init, domain add|remove, profile add|remove|set-default, include add|remove and skill install|remove: what was created, removed or rewritten.

domain.description: The domain of the item; omitted for root content.

path.description: The file or directory created, removed or rewritten, relative to the working directory when below it. For a profile, include or installed skill: the config file holding the entry.

source.description: The source of an include or installed skill, credentials redacted.

domains.description: The domains of a created profile.

default.description: The profile is (now) the default profile.

local.description: The change went to the machine-local layer (--local).
